title: Tags and metadata on goals and tasks, including whether each was filed to NextLevel, kept in the records so it survives the session closing

requirements.text: genlock can add and remove tags on a goal or task, and set key-value metadata
requirements.check: genlock tag a task, then genlock overview shows the tag

requirements.text: Filing to NextLevel marks each filed task or goal with a filed tag and the event id
requirements.check: file: the records for a filed task carry the tag and id

requirements.text: genlock can list done tasks not yet filed to NextLevel
requirements.check: the list command returns done tasks lacking the filed tag

evidence: tests/tags.mjs: tag +#ui/-charts, meta set/clear show in 'genlock show' (tags: #ui, meta: owner=design team) and snapshot tickets[].tags/meta; goals too; 'genlock overview PROJECT' prints 'task #N: theme: ... #design' (overview driven with GENLOCK_APP_PROJECTS); npm test all 5 suites pass

genlock unfiled on this repo -> 58 finished tasks; tests/tags.mjs: lists only done tasks (open 'export' absent), empties after filed, re-lists export once done; --to changelog tracks separately; overview prints 'N finished not filed to nextlevel' once a project has filed anything

genlock filed T.. --event claude-dev-abc1234 writes tag filed:nextlevel + meta nextlevel.event/filed_at; tests/tags.mjs reads .genlock/records/T-*.jsonl and finds both; refuses unfinished work. The filing path is an agent instruction, not code: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md NextLevel section now says run genlock filed after every ok POST, and retract with tag --remove

answers.observed: tests/tags.mjs 4/4 and full npm test pass; unfiled on real repo lists 58
answers.absence: no real NextLevel filing was run: a real POST reaches TJ's phone, so the tag was proven in a temp repo, not on a real filed task
answers.assumption: the filing path is the CLAUDE.md instruction; agents filing from other machines or the NextLevel app's own agent-setup copy will not know to run genlock filed
answers.falsify: the next real NextLevel filing leaves the task untagged (genlock unfiled still lists it)
